name: Yang Depth Defect
definition: For a nonempty binary class $C\subseteq\{0,1\}^n$, let $\Delta_C$ be the Yang complex with facet $F_c=\{(i,c_i):i\in[n]\}$ for each concept. Over a field $k$, define $\delta_{\mathrm{CM},k}(C)=n-\operatorname{depth} k[\Delta_C]$.
parameters: A coefficient field $k$; positive values may depend on the field.
normalization: The zero-coordinate singleton has value zero. This is a depth defect, distinct from Yang dimension defined through the projective dimension of an Alexander-dual ideal.
